title: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (Defender for Endpoint API, read-only application permissions)
readScopes: WindowsDefenderATP application permission Machine.Read.All (GET /api/machines and GET /api/deviceavinfo), with admin consent.
WindowsDefenderATP application permission Vulnerability.Read.All (GET /api/vulnerabilities/machinesVulnerabilities), with admin consent.
WindowsDefenderATP application permission SecurityRecommendation.Read.All (GET /api/recommendations and /api/recommendations/{id}/machineReferences), with admin consent.

checks.title: Each device Defender for Endpoint sees is onboarded
checks.scope: Every machine GET /api/machines lists (up to --defender-max-devices), one result per machine, from onboardingStatus: onboarded passes, CanBeOnboarded (discovered, not onboarded) fails, Unsupported and InsufficientInfo are skipped. Devices Defender has never seen are not listed.

checks.title: Each onboarded device's sensor is active and reported within the last 14 days
checks.scope: Every onboarded machine: healthStatus Active and lastSeen (the last full device report) within --defender-seen-days. Inactive, ImpairedCommunication, NoSensorData and NoSensorDataImpairedCommunication fail; Unknown is skipped.

checks.title: Microsoft Defender Antivirus runs in active mode on each device
checks.scope: Every device in the antivirus health export (GET /api/deviceavinfo), from avMode: 0 Active passes; 2 Disabled fails; 1 Passive, 4 EDRBlocked and 5 PassiveAudit fail unless --defender-allow-passive says another antivirus is primary; Other is skipped. The real-time protection setting is not reported by this API and is not judged.

checks.title: Each device's Microsoft Defender Antivirus security intelligence and engine are up to date
checks.scope: Every device in the antivirus health export: avIsSignatureUpToDate and avIsEngineUpToDate both True pass, either False fails, Unknown is skipped. Microsoft's own up-to-date judgment is used; no version is compared here.

checks.title: No more onboarded devices than allowed are at a High exposure level
checks.scope: One tenant result: the count of onboarded machines whose exposureLevel is High, against --defender-max-exposure (default 0). Skipped when no machine reports a level or the machine list was capped.

checks.title: No more devices than allowed have a critical vulnerability
checks.scope: One tenant result: the count of distinct machines with at least one vulnerability of severity Critical (GET /api/vulnerabilities/machinesVulnerabilities), against --defender-max-exposure; the detail says how many are fixed by a Microsoft update not yet installed (fixingKbId). Vulnerability age is not judged.

checks.title: No device is listed under the 'Turn on Tamper Protection' security recommendation
checks.scope: One tenant result from the security-control recommendations (GET /api/recommendations): exposedMachinesCount 0 passes, more fails with the first device ids. Skipped when the recommendation is not listed, since its absence does not show tamper protection is on.
